(I know) I know it's true
I know it's true, I know it's true
I, I know it's true, I know, I know
It's a vibe
I know it's true, I know it's true
I know (I know)
Going up in flames
Burning deep inside, I don't think I could ever change
Maybe one day, but for now I got nothing to gain
Love my mom to death, but she know we are not the same
Black skies, blue bills, my eyes turning red
Purple stones encrusted, I can't heal just yet
Yellow looking orange, I'm probably high off these meds
Strange things are happening, I swear that's the feds
Most niggas that got it out for me I never met

Phantom at the crib, it must be haunted in here
Jumping out her body with a skelly Cartier
All she want is Japanese skincare
And she want the ice man to sleep here
I can't sleep without a fucking heater in here
Does your baby daddy got the keys to here?
If he does, I probably gotta leave you here

I bet that you're getting a procedure this year

Dancing in my kitchen, it's Ibiza in here

According to my plane, forty people fit on here
The way she say my name, you know how deep it get out here
I know it's true, I know it's true
I know it's true
I, I know it's true, I know, I know
It's a vibe
I know it's true, I know it's true
I know (I know)
